pr_title: Fixes EqualWeightingPortfolioConstructionModel not flattening expired insights
pr_body:
#### Description
- When there are or aren't new insights, the EqualWeightingPortfolioConstructionModel will creates a target to flatten delisted securities from the universe of expired insights.
- Helper methods were added to deal with removing expired insights and getting active ones and used in `EqualWeightingPortfolioConstructionModel`
- Adds unit test
- Updates framework algorithms

#### Related Issue
Closes #2380 

#### Motivation and Context
Fixes bugs in EqualWeightingPortfolioConstructionModel.

#### Requires Documentation Change
Yes. We should state in documentation that this model will remove expired insights.

#### How Has This Been Tested?
Unit and regression tests.

pr_comments: Please consider the impact of this PR on these changes: https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/pull/2385

One of the more complex refactors to date despite being a fairly simple model. The EWPCM considers a number of points in this refactor:

 - When an asset is delisted from the universe; we should remove it from the insights collection and send a signal to the execution model to trigger a position flattening.

- When there are multiple signals for different periods we should allocate accordingly to the one which is expiring soonest. E.g. 1-day downtrend combined with a 1-minute uptrend. This allows people to manually trigger short-term insights for scalping style models while also being compatible with long-term rebalancing strategies.

 - Even when there are no insight changes; the weighting of the assets can change significantly over a few days as the prices move. We needed a rebalancing _period_ in addition to the simple rebalancing on insight expirations.

 - When insights expire; only flatten the position when there are no _other active_ insights in the collection. Be smarter about handing those expirations to minimize fees.

Thanks to @AlexCatarino @mchandschuh

issue_context.title: Equal Weighting Portfolio Model Not Flattening Expired Insights
issue_context.body:
#### Expected Behavior
When an insight expires (time > start+period) it the portfolio construction model should remove the position.

#### Actual Behavior
EWPCM holds the position until another one comes along.

#### Potential Solution
Check expirations flatten positions independent of other insights. 

#### Reproducing the Problem
And short timeframe alpha model will appear to hold like a portfolio.

review_comments:
Is this check require? Looks like we untrust the return value of `RemoveExpiredInsights`. Python version has the same check.
Also, I was thinking that maybe moving the call to `RemoveExpiredInsights` before `GetActiveInsights` would avoid some double work

it's possible to have multiple insights for a given symbol -- so some of those may have expired while others have not. We only want to zero out those that have expired *and* have not received a new one.
